== Notes ==
* Useful when a single interrupt can [[shutdown]] all or most of the enemy:
** In [[PvP]] arenas — to prevent the opposing team's use of [[Resurrection Signet|Resurrection Signets]].
** In areas such as [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]], [[Urgoz's Warren]], and [[The Deep]] — where 10-20 identically-skilled foes confront the [[party]].
* When you successfully interrupt a skill, a visual effect similar to [[Blackout]] will activate on the target and foes carrying the same skill.
* Disables skills even if the interruption is prevented.
